blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government’s accounting office did not regularly receive reports on PhilHealth claims from its hospitals, leaving ₱183.02 million in receivables unrecorded in its books as of Dec. 31, 2025, state auditors found.
